# Capsules

The commands `mt help` lists under Capsules. Sandboxes are known as capsules in Maitento, which is why these commands start with `capsule-`. More in [Capsules](../../../concepts/capsules.md).

In a terminal, type `mt` and then the command. In the interactive shell and the cloud shell, type the command on
its own. `mt help <command>` shows the same details in your terminal.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`capsule-add-user`](#capsule-add-user) | Add a Linux user to a live capsule run (queued: follow it with capsule-command-await) |
| [`capsule-command-await`](#capsule-command-await) | Wait for a command in a capsule run to finish and show its result (exits 1 if it fails, times out or the run ends first) |
| [`capsule-command-get`](#capsule-command-get) | Show the status and output of a command in a capsule run |
| [`capsule-delete`](#capsule-delete) | Delete a capsule definition (refused while it has live runs or an automation starts it) |
| [`capsule-exec`](#capsule-exec) | Queue a command in a live capsule run and print its id, without waiting for it (follow it with capsule-command-await) |
| [`capsule-get`](#capsule-get) | Show a capsule definition and one of its versions: template, packages, users, mounts and startup commands |
| [`capsule-history`](#capsule-history) | List capsule runs, live and ended, newest first (of one capsule when named, else of the namespace; every namespace with `--all`) |
| [`capsule-install-package`](#capsule-install-package) | Install a Debian package in a live capsule run, with apt (queued: follow it with capsule-command-await) |
| [`capsule-list`](#capsule-list) | List the capsule definitions of every namespace, or of one with `--namespace` |
| [`capsule-mount-secret`](#capsule-mount-secret) | Mount a secret as a file at /mnt/secrets/&lt;mount-name> in a live capsule run (queued: follow it with capsule-command-await) |
| [`capsule-mount-vfs`](#capsule-mount-vfs) | Mount a file system at /mnt/&lt;mount-name> in a live capsule run (queued: follow it with capsule-command-await) |
| [`capsule-ps`](#capsule-ps) | List the live capsule runs in a namespace, oldest first |
| [`capsule-remove-package`](#capsule-remove-package) | Remove a package from a live capsule run (queued: follow it with capsule-command-await) |
| [`capsule-remove-user`](#capsule-remove-user) | Remove a Linux user from a live capsule run (queued: follow it with capsule-command-await) |
| [`capsule-start`](#capsule-start) | Start a capsule and print the run's id without waiting for it (a capsule is a short-lived Linux sandbox) |
| [`capsule-terminate`](#capsule-terminate) | Terminate a live capsule run (queued: the run ends shortly after) |
| [`capsule-unmount-secret`](#capsule-unmount-secret) | Unmount a secret from a live capsule run (queued: follow it with capsule-command-await) |
| [`capsule-unmount-vfs`](#capsule-unmount-vfs) | Unmount a file system from a live capsule run (queued: follow it with capsule-command-await) |

## capsule-add-user

Add a Linux user to a live capsule run (queued: follow it with capsule-command-await).

```text
mt capsule-add-user <process-id> <username> [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<process-id>` | text | yes |  | The capsule run's id |
| `<username>` | text | yes |  | The new user's name: lowercase letters, digits, _ and -, at most 32 characters, not root |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--sudo-as, -s, --sudo-as <value>` | text |  |  | Other users of the capsule this user may run commands as with sudo, comma-separated |

## capsule-command-await

Wait for a command in a capsule run to finish and show its result (exits 1 if it fails, times out or the run ends first).

```text
mt capsule-command-await <process-id> <command-id> [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<process-id>` | text | yes |  | The capsule run's id |
| `<command-id>` | text | yes |  | The command's id, as the command that queued it printed |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--poll-interval, -i, --interval <number>` | whole number |  | `500` | How often to check, in milliseconds |
| `--timeout, -t, --timeout <number>` | whole number |  |  | The longest to wait, in seconds (0 for no limit) |

## capsule-command-get

Show the status and output of a command in a capsule run.

```text
mt capsule-command-get <process-id> <command-id>
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<process-id>` | text | yes |  | The capsule run's id |
| `<command-id>` | text | yes |  | The command's id, as the command that queued it printed |

## capsule-delete

Delete a capsule definition (refused while it has live runs or an automation starts it).

```text
mt capsule-delete [name] [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<name>` | text |  |  | Name of the capsule, or name@namespace (or give `--id` instead) |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--namespace, -ns <value>` | text |  |  | The namespace to use (default: your default namespace; see ns-get) |
| `--id, -i <id>` | id |  |  | The capsule's id, instead of its name |
| `--confirm` | flag |  |  | Delete it; without this the command only shows what would be deleted |

## capsule-exec

Queue a command in a live capsule run and print its id, without waiting for it (follow it with capsule-command-await).

```text
mt capsule-exec <process-id> <command> [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<process-id>` | text | yes |  | The capsule run's id |
| `<command>` | text | yes |  | The command: a program name, or a whole shell command line |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--args, --args <value>` | text |  |  | The command's arguments, comma-separated; each is passed as one literal word |
| `--user, -u, --user <value>` | text |  |  | The capsule user to run it as (default: the capsule's default user) |
| `--timeout, -t, --timeout <number>` | whole number |  | `300` | The longest the command may run before it is stopped, in seconds |
| `--async, -a, --async` | flag |  |  | Run it in the background: the capsule starts its next command without waiting for this one |

## capsule-get

Show a capsule definition and one of its versions: template, packages, users, mounts and startup commands.

```text
mt capsule-get <name> [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<name>` | text | yes |  | The capsule, as name@namespace (the namespace is always needed here) |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--version <number>` | whole number |  |  | The version to show (default: the latest) |

## capsule-history

List capsule runs, live and ended, newest first (of one capsule when named, else of the namespace; every namespace with `--all`).

```text
mt capsule-history [name] [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<name>` | text |  |  | Only runs of this capsule: its name, or name@namespace |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--namespace, -ns <value>` | text |  |  | The namespace to use (default: your default namespace; see ns-get) |
| `--all, -a` | flag |  |  | List the runs of every namespace (ignored when a name is given) |
| `--state, -s <value>` | text |  |  | Only runs in this state: active (queued or running), waiting (on a person, an approval or a resume) or terminal (ended) |
| `--limit, -l <number>` | whole number |  | `20` | Maximum number of runs to list (1-200) |
| `--cursor <value>` | text |  |  | The cursor a previous page printed, for the next page |

## capsule-install-package

Install a Debian package in a live capsule run, with apt (queued: follow it with capsule-command-await).

```text
mt capsule-install-package <process-id> <package-name>
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<process-id>` | text | yes |  | The capsule run's id |
| `<package-name>` | text | yes |  | The package's name, such as jq |

## capsule-list

List the capsule definitions of every namespace, or of one with `--namespace`.

```text
mt capsule-list [options]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--namespace <value>` | text |  |  | Only the capsules in this namespace (default: every namespace) |

## capsule-mount-secret

Mount a secret as a file at /mnt/secrets/&lt;mount-name> in a live capsule run (queued: follow it with capsule-command-await).

```text
mt capsule-mount-secret <process-id> <secret-name> <mount-name>
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<process-id>` | text | yes |  | The capsule run's id |
| `<secret-name>` | text | yes |  | Name of the secret to mount |
| `<mount-name>` | text | yes |  | The file name under /mnt/secrets: letters, digits, _ and - |

## capsule-mount-vfs

Mount a file system at /mnt/&lt;mount-name> in a live capsule run (queued: follow it with capsule-command-await).

```text
mt capsule-mount-vfs <process-id> <vfs-id> <vfs-namespace-id> <mount-name>
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<process-id>` | text | yes |  | The capsule run's id |
| `<vfs-id>` | text | yes |  | The file system's id |
| `<vfs-namespace-id>` | text | yes |  | The id of the file system's namespace |
| `<mount-name>` | text | yes |  | The folder name under /mnt: letters, digits, _ and -, not already in use |

## capsule-ps

List the live capsule runs in a namespace, oldest first.

```text
mt capsule-ps [options]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--namespace, -ns <value>` | text |  |  | The namespace to use (default: your default namespace; see ns-get) |

## capsule-start

Start a capsule and print the run's id without waiting for it (a capsule is a short-lived Linux sandbox).

```text
mt capsule-start <name> [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<name>` | text | yes |  | Name of the capsule to start |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--namespace, -ns <value>` | text |  |  | The namespace to use (default: your default namespace; see ns-get) |

## capsule-terminate

Terminate a live capsule run (queued: the run ends shortly after).


|---|---|---|---|---|
